definitions.explanation: The anticipated outcome or future possibility.
The likelihood that something will happen.

examples.japanese: {回復|かいふく}の{見込|みこ}みがない。
{売上|うりあげ}は{前年|ぜんねん}の20%{増|ぞう}の{見込|みこ}みです。
examples.english: Sales are expected to increase by 20% from last year.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{見込|みこ}みのある{若者|わかもの}だ。

notes:
FORMATION:
{見込|みこ}む (to anticipate) → {見込|みこ}み (noun form)

USAGE:
・{見込|みこ}みがある (there's hope/a chance)
・{見込|みこ}みがない (there's no hope)
・{見込|みこ}み{違|ちが}い (miscalculation, misjudgment)
・{見込|みこ}み{客|きゃく} (prospective customer)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{成功|せいこう}の{見込|みこ}み (chance of success)
・{完成|かんせい}の{見込|みこ}み (expected completion)
・{見込|みこ}み{通|どお}り (as expected)
